```python
def add_string(lst, fmt):
    return [fmt.format(x) for x in lst]


assert add_string([1, 2, 3, 4], 'temp{0}') == ['temp1', 'temp2', 'temp3', 'temp4']
```

The `{0}` placeholder is a `str.format` field, so `'temp{0}'.format(1)` gives `'temp1'`. The two alternatives in the note don't satisfy this assert. `'temp{0}' % i` raises `TypeError` because the string has no `%s` placeholder, and `'temp{0}' + str(i)` gives `'temp{0}1'`.
